description: This plot illustrates the "Hidden State Mean" across different layers for three distinct configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines, none of which employ markers. The blue dashed line, labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, maintains a relatively steady, low value with minor fluctuations between 0.2 and 0.5 up to layer 17, and then exhibits a sharp upward trend, reaching approximately 0.9 at layer 19, spiking to 2.6 at layer 21, and peaking at approximately 4.3 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," starts near 0 at layer 0 and remains consistently low, showing a very slight gradual increase to end at approximately 0.1 at layer 23, with a minor dip near layer 21. The green solid line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," also starts near 0 at layer 0 and maintains a steady, nearly flat trend close to 0 across the entire x-axis, ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
